_about: Terrain types (RULES.md §3) and trench maximums (RULES.md §9.5). 'draw' says how the map shows each type: 'fill' paints the whole box (only one fill per box, highest 'priority' wins), 'pattern' is drawn on top, 'badge' adds a mark and a heavy border. Column shifts and other effects will be read from here by the combat code in Milestone 5. See docs/DATA.md.

types.name: Flooded
types.effect: −2 columns for attacks into this box.

types.name: Ridge / high ground
types.effect: −1 column. The defender sees everything coming.

types.name: Flanders mud
types.effect: −1 column in Sep, Oct and Nov. Trenches can't go deeper than level 2.

types.name: Chalk
types.effect: Deep dugouts: trenches can reach level 3 from June 1915.

trenchMax._about: Each period runs from 'from' (YYYY-MM) until the next one. 'normal' is the limit for most boxes; 'byTerrain' overrides it for boxes with that terrain (if a box had two, the lower limit wins).
